title: LLM Health Response
description: Gate 2 (v0.6.2) — response shape for GET /api/health. Reports LLM reachability state from the module-level LLMHealthMonitor singleton.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag for this response shape. 'llm-health-v1' for Gate 2.

status.description: healthy=no failures; degraded=1+ failures but circuit not yet open; down=circuit open.

consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive LLM call failures since last success.

circuit_open.description: True when the circuit breaker has tripped (requests blocked until cooldown expires).

seconds_since_last_success.description: Elapsed seconds since last successful LLM call. null if no successful call yet in this process lifetime.

seconds_since_last_failure.description: Elapsed seconds since last LLM call failure. null if no failures yet.
